purpose: A stable identifier hierarchy for monthly products and a future full-year bundle.

bundle.title: Morning Work Math: Full-Year Bundle
bundle.includes: Twelve released monthly products, each with its PDF, answer keys, thumbnails, listing copy, and release record.
bundle.completenessRule: A month is included only when its release status is released and every required artifact passes QA.

futureMonthRules: Use the same identifier pattern for every month.
Keep the month number in the product identifier even when the display title uses the month name.
Do not restructure existing identifiers when adding a new month.
A bundle references released product identifiers; it does not duplicate or rename them.
